recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban music cover featuring a central oval beverage-style logo parody, a stylized portrait of a man in a beanie pointing at the viewer, and bold, layered typography against a blurred, branded background.
coreVisualRelationships: The central oval logo acts as the primary visual anchor, overlapping the subject.
The subject's hand gesture directs the viewer's eye toward the center-right.
Layered text at the top creates a hierarchy of artist names using varying colors and depths.
The background uses a blurred version of the central logo to create depth and brand cohesion.
coreInvariants: Maroon and white color palette derived from soda branding.
Heavy use of drop shadows to separate layers.
Central oval graphic with a swooping tail on the initial letter.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant, scaled to approximately one-third of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large maroon oval logo with white script lettering in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top artist name, moves down to the central logo, then follows the subject's pointing hand back toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with text, graphics, and a blurred background.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (Logo lettering, Beanie text, Secondary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light Grey (Large secondary artist name with shadow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the maroon tones; high value contrast between white text and dark shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a condensed, heavy sans-serif with a slight inner glow.
Secondary artist name uses a wide, blocky sans-serif with a significant drop shadow.
Central logo uses a custom script with a long, curved tail on the 'P' and rounded terminals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' in the central logo features a large, sweeping underline that cradles the rest of the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, condensed sans-serif for metadata and a fluid, expressive script for the central brand identity.

preserve: The condensed sans-serif for the top title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the top artist name.
Approximates the fluid, branded look of the central logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a blurred background featuring a large, out-of-focus maroon and white oval logo. In the lower right, place a high-contrast, slightly desaturated photo of a man in a black beanie and grey hoodie, pointing his finger toward the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a central maroon oval with a white border. Inside, place custom script text with a heavy drop shadow. At the top, add two layers of bold sans-serif text: one in maroon and one in light grey with a deep shadow.

verificationChecks: Does the central logo have a heavy drop shadow?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to make the foreground pop?
Are the colors limited to the maroon, white, and grey palette?
Is the subject partially obscured by the central logo?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the maroon (from bright red to deep burgundy)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between text and background
Consistent lighting on the subject and logo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 'Parental Advisory' style badge is in the bottom left corner.
Check that the central logo is the largest element.
Verify the top text is centered and uses two distinct styles.
Confirm the subject is pointing toward the center.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a beverage-inspired oval logo with high-contrast urban photography and layered, heavy-weight typography to create a street-style music cover.
